Recorded claim:
D208446 requested a direct import instead of a dynamic module import in the AutoTreeView test fixture. The accepted fixture uses a static side-effect import for auto-tree-view.mjs, with a one-line import/no-unassigned-import exception. The class-export modules in this stack use PascalCase filenames such as TreeDataAdapter.mjs, TreeSelection.mjs, and AddrBookDataAdapter.mjs, while widget registration modules such as auto-tree-view.mjs keep kebab case. These are local naming patterns, not proof of a project-wide rule.

Provenance: 1fb2956187d54e9faa53e3cda68b351af82e00ff414299642db2ca3f675f0d96. Original evidence IDs: 4a7e1d9f76bdae71e1df1b6a157e4a3d7f6d40e570f230fa156f5a582045834d, 74a9b2fe065d9c344d4544d9716ef481a88397a9fc726ae1c5d0326358c0fe8e, a34d7dabf145f264585d1277d6f6ad2ce603da31fad20f95fca21eefbf194cb9.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
